text: I've been holding on this line long enough so I'll just type it out. Granddaughter, 8. Been pulling at her right ear since teatime and says it hurts. Temperature was 37.7, I think, if this thermometer is any good. She's breathing normally, nothing wrong there. She has a bruise on her shin but she banged it on the climbing frame at the park on Saturday, we all saw her do it, so don't worry about that. Mainly want to know if this ear needs a doctor or if it'll settle by itself. Somebody answer please.
